name: Jade jungle canopy trees
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Exactly4 whole plants in separate large cells. Complete root/trunk-to-crown forms; smaller coherent leaf/bark/canopy or side inset, no humans, soil pedestals, attached architecture. Distinct species silhouettes, realistic branching and restrained local natural palette. Do not turn plants into disconnected bouquets. Botanical labels are concept names, not validated specimens. Title "T04-CANOPY-001 — Jade jungle canopy trees". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Distinct jungle canopy forms; complete coherent trunks/root flares, broad natural green leaves. Aerialroots from actual branches, not disconnected tentacles.
